name: input
useFor: Use for one line of text: a handle, an email, a key. Pair it with Label (or Field) above it. Set aria-invalid when the value is rejected and say why below it; set readOnly for a value the person cannot change (it sits on the lilac).
constraints: A placeholder used as the only label
A gray field background for an editable value

title: Input
description: The 40px field with 8px corners, the lilac-gray edge and a light purple placeholder.
